name: @linxin666/dsh-verifier
description: DSH Verifier mode: a TurboAgent-equivalent automatic best-of-N agent pipeline plus the pinned, unmodified LLM-as-a-Verifier 0.2.0 framework. Supports custom DSH generation models, custom verifier backends/models, PPT selection, progress tracking, multimodal scoring, exact token/cache accounting, and official benchmarks.

scripts.check: for f in lib/*.js test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dsh-verifier-pycache" python3 -m py_compile assets/sidecar.py test/fake_openai.py test/integration.py && echo all source files OK
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:preset && npm run test:agent && npm run test:integration
